Kwenta is a decentralized trading platform that is built on the Synthetix protocol. Kwenta enables trading of synthetic assets and perpetual futures. Kwenta runs on Layer 2 networks, including Optimism and Base. Kwenta is governed by holders of its KWENTA governance token.

MakerDAO is a decentralized lending protocol that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. MakerDAO issues the DAI stablecoin against overcollateralized vaults. MakerDAO is governed by holders of its MKR governance token.

Hyperliquid is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange. Hyperliquid runs its own Layer 1 blockchain. Hyperliquid operates an on-chain order book for trading. Hyperliquid has a native token called HYPE.

Compound is an algorithmic money market protocol that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Compound pools supplied assets so that suppliers and borrowers transact against a common pool. Compound sets interest rates algorithmically based on supply and demand. Compound issues cTokens to suppliers as receipts for their deposits. Compound is governed by holders of its COMP governance token.

Aave is a non-custodial liquidity protocol that allows users to supply and borrow assets. Aave offers both variable and stable interest rate borrowing. Aave provides flash loans that must be repaid within a single transaction. Aave is governed by holders of its AAVE governance token.
